title.narrative: IHP – Enhancing Climate-Resilient Water Governance and Partnerships

description.narrative: This activity will support efforts in Egypt and the region to strengthen climate-resilient water management through targeted policy development, technical innovation, and capacity building. It will enhance groundwater governance and scale up the application of climate adaptation tools, while promoting the use of scientific and technological solutions, including advanced approaches for water management. In parallel, the activity will foster national dialogue and knowledge exchange through key platforms, contributing to more coordinated, evidence-based, and sustainable water resource management in Egypt.
